THEME DOCUMENTATION
willemstad.cc
Please install the 'Settings Search' plugin by javalent to find settings faster.
Please note that Willemstad is only supported on the default (non-legacy) editor on desktop at the moment. Mobile support will be rolled out at a later date.
Colour Palettes
Choose a colour palette!
Default: 🟢 Revolution — London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine (LSHTM)
🟢 Revolution — London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine (LSHTM)
❄️ Adaptation — Noord [Willemstad-style Nord]
🖌️ Custom Colours
Font Pairings + Enable Custom Fonts
There are two suggested font typeface pairings with Willemstad, available here.
Default: 🟢 Manrope + DM Sans
🟢 Manrope + DM Sans
⚫ Inter (v3.19)
⭕ Custom Fonts
True Black mode
When enabled, this makes the dark mode True Black.
No Animations
When enabled, this disables all animations in this theme.
Use Standard Obsidian Icons
When enabled, this replaces the custom Willemstad icon set with the standard Obsidian icons.
Startup Screen
Startup Background Image, Dotted Grid Overlay, Loading Message Prefix, Gradient Startup Progress Bar
Titlebar
Choose which titlebar style you would like to use for Obsidian.
Default: 🌥️ Default Bar
💫 Mini-sized Bar
🌥️ Default Bar
❌ No Bar — Completely removes bar
Titlebar Customisation
Customise the titlebar elements here.
Status Bar
Choose which status bar you would like to use for Obsidian.
Default: 💫 Conjuring — Hidden until hovered, mini-size
💫 Conjuring — Hidden until hovered, mini-size
🌥️ Enduring — Persistent, mini-size
☀️ Unchanging — Persistent, full-length (Obsidian default)
❌ Hiding — Completely removes bar
Ribbon
Choose which ribbon/sidebar/side docks style you would like to use for Obsidian.
Default: Floating Tabs — tabs that come into full-view when hovered
Floating Tabs — tabs that come into full-view when hovered
Styled Bars
Default Bars
No Bars — hide all bars
Ribbon Customisation
Customise the ribbon/sidebar elements here.
Navigation, Navigation Pane, Sidebar Panes and Sidebar Tabs
Customise the abovementioned elements here.
Modals
Change the widths and heights of modals (the settings/community plugins/themes/Publish menus).
